question: Will the 10-year U.S. Treasury par yield (Treasury daily par yield curve) for 2024-04-14 (or the last business day before it with a published reading) be above 3.96%, its value for 2024-01-12?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-01-15 (2024-01-12), rounded as shown
